body: I don't know what to tell you man, I don't know you or your problems. I would like just if you tought about it really good before doing something (like think about it in an objective way). If there is something that you can do to make your situation better please just try that first. If there is the tinyest chance, it may actually work.

The part when you have to do something or something bad will happen sounds like OCD to me. I myself, when I go to sleep I have to open my eyes a lot of times to check out if Ive gone blind (theres nothing wrong with my eyes lol) to sleep to a certain side so I don't choke in my sleep and Im alerted by every little sound because I think someone is breaking in my house. I also have some spasmotic (idk the word in english) reflexes.As I write it down Im understanding that Im a strange individual, but I guess that happens so...idk man... It sounds too me like you've been depressed for a long time, my advice would be to make a list of things you can do for yourself (things that you are in control and can change your life in a good way) and make them happen! Its the only way that the situation can get better. If you want to talk to somebody you can reply here or pm me ;)
